lines: It has not happened. The missiles, the bases and the timings are real, and every number has a source.

shots.caption: Russia launches a nuclear strike on America. Minute by minute.

shots.label: nuclear warheads in the world
shots.sub: Russia and the United States hold almost nine in ten. About 1,700 strategic warheads deployed on each side.
shots.source: FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2025; SIPRI Yearbook 2025
Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists, Russian nuclear weapons 2025

lines: in the first few hours. Fallout and the collapse of hospitals come after.

shots.caption: Average temperatures fall for years. Harvests fail.

shots.line: NORAD · a training tape shows a full Soviet attack · the adviser is minutes from calling the president

shots.sub: random numbers written into the missile-warning messages. Twice in a week the screens showed an attack.

shots.caption: 1995: a Norwegian science rocket, read by Russian radar as a possible missile

shots.label: to midnight · 27 January 2026
shots.sub: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists. The closest the Doomsday Clock has ever been.

shots.line: 5 February 2026 · no treaty limit on strategic weapons for the first time in half a century

shots.caption: Eighty-one years. Every person with the authority to launch has decided not to.

lines: The only way to keep the thirty minutes on this map is for the first decision never to be made.

shots.title: Next scenario
shots.line: China blockades Taiwan, and the first nuclear weapon since 1945 is used. New scenario every day.
